nary_nodes.label: Microsoft cuts 4,800 jobs
evidence: Microsoft has announced it has cut 4,800 jobs - roughly 2.1% of its workforce - with Xbox to bear a large number of its latest layoffs.

nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type covers layoffs; minting a new subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Xbox significant restructure
evidence: Asha Sharma, who recently took over as Xbox's chief executive, said in a note to staff it was "beginning the most significant restructure in Xbox history".
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where an organization changes its structure or operations.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type fits restructuring; minting a new subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Four Xbox studios spun off
evidence: Four Xbox game development studios - Compulsion Games, Double Fine Productions, Ninja Theory and Undead Lab - would also be spun off as part of the changes, she added.

nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type covers spinoffs; minting a new subtype.

nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type covers price increases; minting a new subtype.

nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where a company eliminates jobs or positions.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event type covers job cuts; minting a new subtype.

nary_nodes.label: Coleman: focus on customer delivery
evidence: Amy Coleman, executive vice president at Microsoft, told employees in a memo that the tech giant needed to focus on areas that can deliver for customers amid a "fast-changing industry".

nary_nodes.label: Sharma: changes for bigger future
evidence: "These changes are about a bigger future for Xbox, not a smaller one," Sharma said in a note, shared on X.

nary_nodes.label: Coleman: companies must change
evidence: "Companies don't get to choose whether their industry changes; they only get to choose whether they change with it," she said.

nary_nodes.label: Coleman: AI changing work
evidence: She noted that while the company would not replace the lost roles with AI, "what is true is that AI is changing how work gets done".

nary_nodes.label: Sharma: reset needed
evidence: Sharma said on Monday that while she knew the cuts were "painful", there was a "reset" needed across Xbox's entire content portfolio, platform and operations.

nary_nodes.label: Pescatore: major reset
evidence: Tech analyst Paolo Pescatore told the BBC the changes indeed marked a "major reset" for the company, which has further trials ahead.

nary_nodes.label: Pescatore: challenge defining Xbox
evidence: "The challenge is not just cutting costs; it is defining what Xbox stands for in a world where games are moving across console, PC, cloud and subscription platforms," he said.

nary_nodes.label: Harding-Rolls: underlines vision
evidence: Piers Harding-Rolls of Ampere Analysis said this restructuring "underlines Xbox's vision for its studios and content, which will be more heavily focused on the biggest IP and audiences".

nary_nodes.label: Harding-Rolls: studios better outside
evidence: "But the company has now decided that some of these teams and the games they are building would be better suited to sit outside the Xbox organisation," he said - adding that its decision not close them was "positive news during a difficult time".

nary_nodes.label: Double Fine: thankful
evidence: Double Fine, acquired by Microsoft in 2019, wrote on X that it was "thankful to everyone at Xbox for seven great years together".

nary_nodes.label: Double Fine: preserves history
evidence: The Psychonauts developer added it was grateful to have been able to reach an outcome "which preserves our history and culture, and returns ownership of our games to us".

nary_nodes.label: Compulsion: support team
evidence: "Our immediate priority is to support our team throughout this transition period," Compulsion said on X - adding it was confident in its future.

To be credited as the source of a statement.

To have created or produced in the past.
To produce or manufacture something.
To gain ownership of another company or asset.
To provide a service or product.
To hold the top executive position in an organization.
To hold a senior vice president position in an organization.
To be employed by an organization.
To communicate information to someone.
To publish content on a platform.
To distribute content on a platform.
To happen on a specific date.
To come after in time or order.
To be a component or element of something.

To result in or cause something.
